title: Chat-First Go, Hub & Command PWA Surface Delivery
objective: Turn the approved Titan Go, Titan Hub and Titan Command prototype into three separately installable, production-connected role projections of one canonical Titan Zero TypeScript runtime. Use /Titan Zero/PWA Workspace/WORK/Titan-Zero-PWA-Surfaces-60-Pass-Build-Plan.md as the canonical execution plan. Features required by more than one surface, including agents, autonomy, tier behaviour, capabilities, generative UI, workflows, contracts, events, receipts, offline rules and measurable outcomes, must be implemented once in the canonical base and exposed through governed surface permissions; PWA code may contain presentation, device adaptation and bounded offline behaviour only. The mandatory product experience is TEAM_IN_YOUR_POCKET: the user opens a role surface, speaks naturally to Titan Zero as the front door, the appropriate canonical managers and specialists assemble behind the conversation, and governed generative UI appears only when useful; dashboards and manual agent selection are secondary escape hatches rather than the primary operating model.
